faqs.q: What is Black and Galvanised Steel Pipe, ASTM A53 used for?
faqs.a: Seamless and welded carbon steel pipe to ASTM A53, black or hot-dip galvanised, by NPS and schedule under ASME B36.10M, for water, air, gas and steam lines and structural use. It is listed in 44 sizes, 21.3–219.1 mm outside diameter.

faqs.q: How do I read an Indus part number for Black and Galvanised Steel Pipe, ASTM A53, such as IH-TF-CP-BLK-N0050-STDS40?
faqs.a: Black and Galvanised Steel Pipe, ASTM A53 part numbers begin with IH-TF-CP-BLK, then N and the nominal pipe size times 100, then a schedule code: IH-TF-CP-BLK-N0050-STDS40 is NPS 1/2 and STD / SCH 40. The schedule codes in the table are: STDS40 is STD / SCH 40, XSS80 is XS / SCH 80, S160 is SCH 160, XXS is XXS. Quote the full part number, or the NPS and schedule.

faqs.q: What sizes does Black and Galvanised Steel Pipe, ASTM A53 come in?
faqs.a: Black and Galvanised Steel Pipe, ASTM A53 is listed in 44 sizes, 21.3–219.1 mm outside diameter, each with its own Indus part number, for example IH-TF-CP-BLK-N0050-STDS40 and IH-TF-CP-BLK-N0800-XXS. The table includes 21.3 mm OD by 2.77 mm wall and 219.1 mm OD by 22.23 mm wall.

faqs.q: What do I need to send to order Black and Galvanised Steel Pipe, ASTM A53 to the right size and grade?
faqs.a: For Black and Galvanised Steel Pipe, ASTM A53, quote the Indus part number from the size table, or send the standard and grade, the outside diameter and wall (BWG or millimetres, minimum or average wall), the length and the quantity. We quote with the mill certificates and the inspection you need.

faqs.q: Which wall schedules do Black and Galvanised Steel Pipe, ASTM A53 come in?
faqs.a: Black and Galvanised Steel Pipe, ASTM A53 is listed in these schedules: STD / SCH 40, XS / SCH 80, SCH 160, XXS, for pipe from NPS 1/2 to NPS 8 with wall thickness from 2.77 to 23.01 mm. Each size and schedule has its own Indus part number.

faqs.q: Which materials and grades are Black and Galvanised Steel Pipe, ASTM A53 available in?
faqs.a: Black and Galvanised Steel Pipe, ASTM A53 is available in these grades: A53 A; A53 B. If your site needs a particular material grade, coating or material certificate, say so on the enquiry and we confirm it before the order.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to Black and Galvanised Steel Pipe, ASTM A53?
faqs.a: Black and Galvanised Steel Pipe, ASTM A53 is made to ASTM A53/A53M, ASME B36.10M. Tell us the standard and grade on your enquiry; equivalent grades in other standards are indicative and are checked against each tender.

faqs.q: What do Black and Galvanised Steel Pipe, ASTM A53 connect to or fit with?
faqs.a: For Black and Galvanised Steel Pipe, ASTM A53, pipe is joined by welding or threading with fittings, flanges and valves of matching material, wall and pressure class, so size and schedule must match throughout the line. Related ranges are the [Precision & Mechanical Tubes](/c/precision-mechanical-tubes) and [Alloy Steel Boiler & Superheater Tubes](/c/alloy-steel-boiler-superheater-tubes) shelves.

faqs.q: How should Black and Galvanised Steel Pipe, ASTM A53 be inspected on receipt and stored?
faqs.a: Check Black and Galvanised Steel Pipe, ASTM A53 on receipt against the order: outside diameter, wall, length, marking and the certificate heat numbers, and keep the ends capped until installation. Handle and store the material so the surface is not scratched or dented.

faqs.q: How does Black and Galvanised Steel Pipe, ASTM A53 differ from Low-Temperature Carbon Steel Pipe — ASTM A333?
faqs.a: Black and Galvanised Steel Pipe, ASTM A53 differs from [Low-Temperature Carbon Steel Pipe — ASTM A333](/p/low-temperature-carbon-steel-pipe-astm-a333) in its standards ASTM A53/A53M, ASME B36.10M against ASTM A333/A333M, ASTM A334/A334M, ASME B36.10M. It also differs in its base tube material A53 A; A53 B against A333 Gr 1; A333 Gr 3 (3.5Ni); A333 Gr 6; A334 Gr 1; A334 Gr 6.
